description:
Release shared line assignment

Releases a shared line assignment, freeing both its seat and its handle for reassignment. The row is retained for audit and returned with releasedAt set, so repeating the call is safe. Requires the platforms:write permission bound to the project resource in the path.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/shared-line-assignments/release-shared-line-assignment
name: releaseSharedLineAssignment

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Whether the end user has texted the assigned line from their handle since this assignment was created. Until they have, sends to them on this line are refused; once they have, the project can message them while the assignment is unreleased. A released assignment keeps its opt-in, and a re-created assignment starts pending. This records only that Photon allows replies; it is not a consent record for SMS compliance.

receivedAt.description: When the end user sent that first text, as the platform reports it. Present exactly when state is received.
